entries.category_description: Exemptions and super-reduced rates (Article 105a(1) of the VAT Directive)
entries.comment: Children clothing, if clearly intended for children of a max. age of thirteen; - Children footwear; for boys up to and included size 40; for girls up to and included size 35.5 (35 if half sizes not available) for pumps, and up to and included size 38.5 (38 if half sizes not available) for any other shoe type unless heel hight, sole hight included, exceeds 4 cm
